title: cerastium fontanum subsp. holosteoides
intro: Cerastium fontanum subsp. holosteoides, commonly known as small-toothed field cinquefoil or holosteoid cinquefoil, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the carnation family Caryophyllaceae. It is used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may aid in wound healing and the treatment of various infections. The plant is said to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant and antiviral properties, making it a potential remedy for conditions like fever, cough, and respiratory infections. Bioactive constituents found in Cerastium fontanum subsp. holosteoides include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
